notes.title: RoBo’s first public playtest has ended
notes.content:
[b]We are happy to share that after 13 days, RoBo’s first public playtest has ended and exceeded our expectations![/b]

Thank you for being involved, thank you for joining the “fun creation” journey and being an integral part of it!
We appreciate every feedback and take your thoughts and ideas into account.

We’ll keep updating our game dev progress, Unreal Engine tips & tricks mainly on Twitter & Discord but also on Facebook, Instagram & LinkedIn.

[b]Soon we’ll have pretty big and exciting news so be sure to stay tuned (;[/b]

We look forward to seeing you on the next public playtest!

notes.title: Infinite Respawn Loop Fix
notes.content:
Hello friends.
We know some of you have encountered the infinite respawn loop issue. Good news! We worked hard so you can still have a great experience and just released a fix for that! 
Hope you'll give it another shot!

notes.title: First Public Playtest
notes.content:
[b][h2]Welcome to “RoBo: The Allectric Idventurer” Playtest![/h2]  [/b]

Thank you for choosing to play our first ever playtest! This playtest is very important to us, your feedback will help us shape the game that you would like to play. 
[u]Please consider submitting a form after your playthrough[/u] –
https://forms.gle/tc712tWnd7DQWQra9

[b]The playtest will be available for a limited time, so don’t miss out![/b]

[h3]Before you begin your journey, a kind advice:[/h3]
RoBo is a family-friendly third-person action puzzle platformer!
This version of the game is very early in development, which means:
-	Not final art 
-	Bugs
-	Performance issues
-	Missing animations
-	Missing sounds 
This playtest includes a part of the first level and should take you about 30 minutes to complete. 


To download RoBo: The Allectric Idventurer press “Request Access” on the game’s Steam store page. The playtest will be added to your game library.
[Requires a steam account.] 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1903430/RoBo_The_Allectric_Idventurer/


[u]Feel free to stream the playtest on different platforms![/u]
 
The playtest supports Keyboard and mouse only.
[h3]Keyboard layout:[/h3]
Movement – WASD 
Jump – Space 
Double Jump – Space + Space 
Transfer Energy – Hold E 
Gain Energy – Hold Q 
Interact – F 
Aim – Right Mouse Button 
Shoot – Left Mouse Button
